sample_rule.selected_by: research agents working from written briefs, on 2026-09-30, before any classification ran
sample_rule.rule: 50 US companies, each with a public signal about .NET, Azure, Power Platform or Dynamics taken from a source other than a job board: 15 Microsoft customer stories, 9 press releases, 8 company service pages, 7 partner case studies, 6 careers pages, 5 leadership-change announcements. 33 signals carry a date; 17 are undated service, careers or leadership pages. One brief asked for end customers, one for hard cases (companies that call themselves IT solutions or consulting firms, IT staffing firms, Microsoft partners, mixed businesses), one for leadership changes and careers pages. One company found by two briefs was kept once; one was added by hand to reach 50.
sample_rule.not_a_client_list: Public sample selected by me, not a client-provided list.
sample_rule.provenance: The company sample and the research prompt were fixed before research. The same records were later rescored twice after reviews: policy v2 added the own-site rule and routing of mixed labels; policy v3 requires positive evidence from the same input for every check, and the quote and signal checks were rerun with checker 2026-09-30.5. The reviews ran again with the input fingerprint.

evaluation.note: The last step counts accepted rows only. A label that the review confirms as mixed would be routed to a person, not counted; none was in this run.

usage.workspace_plan: Clay 14-day trial (postPricingChange2026Trial), 1,000 data credits and 5,000 actions

models.research: Clay Argon, web research (fixed 3 data credits per row)
models.review: Claude Sonnet 5 through Clay, no web access (about 0.7 data credits per row)

final_run.definition: The cost of the final workflow configuration: for every cell, the charge Clay recorded for its latest run (upfront plus reconciliation; no cell was refunded).

whole_workspace_so_far.note: Everything spent in the trial workspace up to that time: building and testing, a review pass that ran before its run condition was saved, one accidental research rerun, the five fixtures, the policy v2 and v3 reruns (quote and signal checks, reviews) and two rewrites of the Evidence table. Not included: the three actions of the row-state demonstration run after that read (three quote checks on the Ntiva row).

price_basis.usd_per_action_source: Growth plan, 40K actions/mo for $205/mo, clay.com/pricing read 2026-09-30
price_basis.plan_note: The HTTP API column needs Clay Growth or Enterprise (clay.com/pricing, 2026-09-30: not included on Free and Launch). Growth monthly: 40K actions for $205 and 6K data credits for $290, $495 a month. The per-company figures are marginal costs on that plan.

usage.external_spend: none: the quote checker runs on Cloudflare Workers free tier; no model API was called outside Clay
